title: Ungraded Lab: Customer Service Agent
module: Module 5 - Patterns for Highly Autonomous Agents

notes.goal: Build an autonomous customer service agent that plans actions by writing Python code rather than JSON, executing database queries and updates safely.

steps.title: Set Up Database Tables
steps.what_happens: Initialize the TinyDB document store with seed data for sunglasses inventory and store transactions.

steps.title: Query Read-Only Inventory
steps.what_happens: Ask the model to find round sunglasses under $100 by generating a Python plan that queries the inventory table.

steps.title: Process a Return
steps.what_happens: Instruct the model to handle a return of 2 Aviator sunglasses, generating code that updates stock and logs a transaction.

steps.title: Build Customer Service Agent
steps.what_happens: Combine code generation and sandboxed execution into an end-to-end agent function that processes multi-item purchases.

notes.results: The notebook ran successfully with zero cell errors and three model calls. The agent successfully generated Python plans, executed them within a safe namespace, accurately updated TinyDB inventory and transaction records, and returned concise customer-facing answers.
